MESSAGE.value:
Fix URI collision checks for hidden folders and unpublished siblings
Hidden year/month folders (news/2025/09, news/2026/09) were rejected as colliding: a transparent folder's own row still stores parent_prefix/segment, so both rows hold "news/09". That URL is unreachable anyway, because a noTarget folder answers with 404. Meanwhile, two unpublished siblings with the same segment were accepted, because the check only queried the live-only DocumentUriPath projection.
Rules now: - Two hidden noTarget folders under different parents may share a uriPath (FolderUriPathLogic::isUnroutableFolder()). Anything reachable still collides: a page vs. a folder, or a folder that redirects (firstChildNode/selectedTarget). - Siblings always collide. UriCollisionCheck::checkSiblings() queries the parent's document children in the command's workspace via the content graph, so unpublished nodes are covered too.
Details: - UriCollisionCheck applies the folder rule on create, rename, hide toggle, move and variant. The unused $candidateHideSegmentInUriPath parameter becomes $candidateIsUnroutableFolder. - The command hook merges NodeType defaults on create. The hook runs before the CR merges them, and the Neos UI sends neither hideSegmentInUriPath nor targetMode. - Changing targetMode re-checks the folder's own uriPath, since leaving noTarget makes it reachable. - The hook and the Inspector endpoint share isUnroutableFolderAfterChange(), which reads from the command's workspace and dimension, so unpublished folders are judged correctly. - CollisionList dedupes conflicts per dimension and node. - New Collision_UnroutableFolders.feature (12 scenarios) and Collision_Workspace.feature (7 scenarios)
